The Senate Committee on Regulated Industries HB 571/AP House Bill 571 (AS PASSED HOUSE AND SENATE) By: Representatives Hawkins of the 27th, Jasperse of the 11th, Dempsey of the 13th, Jackson of the 128th, Silcox of the 53rd, and Utilities offered the following substitute to HB 571: others
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Chapter 34 of Title 43 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to physicians, assistants, and others, so as to provide for the licensing of radiologist assistants; to … to provide for an advisory committee; to provide for statutory construction; to provide for related matters; to provide for an effective date; to repeal conflicting laws; and for other purposes.
BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF GEORGIA: HB 571/AP
SECTION 1. Chapter 34 of Title 43 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to physicians, assistants, and others, is amended by revising subsection (a) of Code Section 43-34-11, relating to continuing education requirement and required training for … this paragraph shall be taken in conformity with the provisions of Code Section 43-34-143. (3) The board shall be authorized to require persons seeking renewal of licensure as clinical perfusionists under Article 7 of this chapter to complete board approved HB 571/AP
continuing education. The board shall be authorized to establish the number of hours of continuing education required biennially for renewal of licensure as a clinical perfusionist and the categories in which these hours should be earned. The board shall … to approve courses offered by institutions of higher learning, specialty societies, or professional organizations. Any action taken by the board pursuant to this paragraph shall be taken in conformity with the provisions of subsection (b) of Code Section 43-34-313.
HB 571/AP (6) The board shall be authorized to require persons seeking renewal of licensure to practice as a radiologist assistant under Article 13 of this chapter to complete board approved continuing education. The board shall be authorized to establish the number … the public, as best possible."
SECTION 2. Said chapter is further amended by repealing Code Section 43-34-12, relating to radiologist assistant defined.
SECTION 3. Said chapter is further amended by adding a new article to read as follows: HB 571/AP
"ARTICLE 13
43-34-330. This article shall be known and may be cited as the 'Radiologist Assistant Act.'
43-34-331. As used in this article, the term: (1) 'Board' means the Georgia Composite Medical Board. (2) 'Radiologist' means a … noninvasive procedures unless said procedures are expressly restricted by the board to not be performed by radiologist assistants under general supervision. Such radiologist assistant may also perform other procedures under general supervision as may be authorized by the board.
HB 571/AP 43-34-332. A person shall be qualified for licensure as a radiologist assistant and the board shall issue a license if that person: (1) Has applied in writing in form and substance satisfactory to the board and is at least 21 … seeking renewal of licensure under this article to complete board approved continuing education; (2) Establish the number of hours of continuing education to be completed as well as the categories in which the continuing education is to be completed; and HB 571/AP
(3) Maintain continued certification and registration as a radiologist assistant with the American Registry of Radiologic technologist or radiology practitioner assistant with the Certification Board for Radiology Practitioner Assistants and the American Registry of Radiologic Technologists. (c) A person … duty within the armed forces of the United States or with the state militia and called into service or training; or (2) In training or education under the supervision of the United States preliminary to induction into military service
HB 571/AP may have his or her license renewed or restored without paying a lapsed renewal fee if, within two years after termination from the service, training, or education except under conditions other than honorable, he or she furnishes the board with … this article. (b) Notwithstanding subsection (a) of this Code section, a radiologist assistant may with general supervision perform other noninvasive procedures unless said procedures are expressly restricted by the board to not be performed by radiologist assistants under general
HB 571/AP supervision. Such radiologist assistant may also perform other procedures under general supervision as may be authorized by the board. (c) A radiologist assistant shall not interpret images, make diagnoses, or prescribe medications or therapies. (d) Any rules and regulations adopted … application, examination, and certification fees; (6) Establish continuing education requirements; and (7) Establish the number of radiologist assistants that may be supervised by a radiologist according to levels of supervision as defined by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services. HB 571/AP
43-34-337. The board shall appoint an advisory committee. The advisory committee shall consist of no fewer than five individuals and shall include at least one licensed physician who practices radiology, three licensed radiologist assistants, and one consumer representative. Members … the United States Department of Veterans Affairs, while engaged in the performance of his or her duties."
SECTION 4. This Act shall become effective upon its approval by the Governor or upon its becoming law without such approval.
HB 571/AP SECTION 5. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
